about: Editor spec §42, problem_codes: the stable code of every problem the drawing reader finds in a note, beyond what the graph spec's reader refuses (packages/graph-spec/src/reader/problem-codes.json, GN1xx to GN6xx). It is given as the Language Server Protocol diagnostic's code, so a problem can be looked up and its words translated. The numbering goes on from that table: 7xx is what the drawing reader finds in a note. A code is never reused and never renumbered: a problem that goes keeps its code retired, and a new one takes the next free number. words are the catalogue keys its message is said with, in packages/core/src/*-source-words.ts; section is the spec § the rule comes from, or null. libraries says which reader raises it: core is the editor's core (packages/core), py the Python library's drawing reader. Where both raise it, both give the same code: drawing-problem-cases.json holds notes each must read to the same codes. Every raise site passes its code as a literal; packages/core/test/note-reading-codes.test.js and python/graph_spec/tests/test_drawing_problem_codes.py hold each reader to this table.
